evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` and carries the `Block storage` label, altering database invariants and corruption handling during block index loading.
rationale: Prevents crashes and out-of-bounds vector reads when loading corrupted block index databases during node startup. PR description notes that corrupt entries previously caused an out-of-bounds vector read or triggered an assertion failure in `CBlockIndex::GetAncestor` instead of cleanly reporting failure.
